newsitem.title: USA: San Antonio feeder cattle steady-$4 lower - USDA.
newsitem.headline: San Antonio feeder cattle steady-$4 lower - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers were steady to $3.00 per cwt lower, with most decline on lighter weights, compared to Monday, USDA. said Feeder heifers were $3.00-$4.00 lower. Bulk of supply Medium and Large 1-2 300-600 lb feeder steers and heifers.
Supply included around 10 percent slaughter cows and bulls; 22 percent feeder cattle over 600 lbs with balance mostly feeder cattle under 600 lbs.
Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 - 600-700 lbs 63.00-67.00. Medium and Large 1-2 - 500-600 lbs 55.25-66.25; 600-750 lb heiferettes 54.25-62.50. Receipts - 543 Last Week - 561 Last Year - 312
